notes: NTR district was not changed by the Dec 2025 reorganisation (The Hindu). The mandal-to-division mapping comes from the official mandals page (6 + 7 + 7 = 20 mandals), consistent with the district profile. The /revenue-divisions/ URL returns 404 on this site. The district profile lists the four municipalities as Tiruvuru, Nandigama, Jaggayyapeta and Ibrahimpatnam; the municipality located in Ibrahimpatnam mandal is Kondapalli Municipality per the district utility page and PMAY 2.0, so 'Kondapalli' is used. The municipality is spelt 'Jaggaiahpet' on the district utility page and the mandal 'Jaggaiahpeta'. Tiruvuru is a municipality per the district profile but a town panchayat per the PMAY 2.0 list; the district classification is used.
